about: How the call listener turns evidence into a level (docs/agents/CONTRACT.md, 'Call listener'). Same logic in data/listen/Fusion.kt and engine/listener/fusion.py. Evidence: cue categories (scam_patterns.json), our scam classifier's p_scam on the transcript ('clf', abstains under ~25 words), context signals from the phone, the voice-clone check (context id 'synthetic_voice': warn at most, never scam on its own) and the user. Levels never go down during a call, except when the user says 'Not a scam'. 'strong' = a category that isn't weak; 'discussion' never counts as a category.
